summary: Frontend-only retest of HIGH bug fixes for duplicate customer & product handling in VANDANA app. All 4 requested flows PASSED. Duplicate 'Ravi Traders' customer -> error toast "Customer 'Ravi Traders' already exists" shown, dialog stayed open, NO dev runtime-error overlay. Duplicate 'GI Pipe' product -> error toast "Product 'GI Pipe' already exists in inventory" shown, dialog stayed open, NO overlay. Unique customer (TEST_Cust_*) and unique product (TEST_Prod_*) creations succeeded with success toasts and new rows visible in customers-table / inventory-table. Dashboard kpi-net-profit and kpi-expenses both render. Bug fix verified.
action_items: Consider cleaning up TEST_Cust_* and TEST_Prod_* seed rows created during this test.
critical_code_review_comments: Dialogs are missing aria-describedby / Description for accessibility (Radix warning in console) — non-blocking but should be fixed.
seed_data_creation: Created one customer TEST_Cust_1786721459 and one product TEST_Prod_1786721468 for the unique-name sanity checks; both persisted in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duplicate 409 handling now works cleanly on both CustomerForm.save and ProductDialog.save via try/catch + toast.error(errMsg(e)). If regressing later, verify dialog stays open on 409 and toast content matches backend detail string. Note: 'Save as PDF' regression was NOT re-tested this iteration (per request keep run lightweight) — it passed in iteration_5 and no related files were changed.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration: create/update calls in CustomerForm and ProductDialog were awaited without try/catch, so backend 409 duplicate responses became unhandled promise rejections that surfaced as the CRA dev 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix wrapped save() bodies in try/catch and called toast.error(errMsg(e)) on failure without invoking markSaved / onSaved, keeping the dialog open. Verified end-to-end in this run.
